'''Sentries''' are a type of [[Mobs|Mob]], placed into the [[Deterrent Parasites|Deterrent]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawned by [[Stage III Dispatcher|Stage III]] and [[Stage IV Dispatcher|Stage IV Dispatchers]].
*Spawned on Infested Blocks by [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
Sentries are Ranged defenders, incapable of movement. 

*Their Ranged Attack is a burst of 3 Poisonous Projectiles, which can melt the Player Armor in few hits. Each hit reduces an armor piece's durability by 4%, and the poison lasts for 7 seconds.
*Sentries can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 7, with a 20-tick cooldown and 3-block range.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Sentries, like any other [[:Category:Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Sentries cannot spawn on any partial blocks.
